Verified live -- the exact same 96-fragment PAPER object one-shot scenario (73/96 GONE before) now produces a real gradient (52 intact, 23 cracked, 11 torn, 10 gone), server log matching exactly. bazel build/test //... clean (19 targets, 8/8 mod tests).
